info.title: Web of Science API Lite
info.description:
A responsive API that supports rich searching across the Web of Science Core Collection to retrieve core article metadata. 
This service provides a great way to reuse Web of Science data both internally and externally to enhance 
institutional repositories and research networking systems with best-in-class data.
This API supports searching across the Web of Science to retrieve item-level
metadata with limited fields: 
- UT (Unique Identifier)
- Authors
- Author keywords
- Document type
- Title
- Issue
- Pages
- Publication date
- Source title
- Volume
- DOI
- ISBN
- ISSN 

The API supports JSON and XML responses, and this
documentation supports trying both response types.

get.summary: Submits a user query and returns results
get.description: The search operation submits a search query to the specified database edition and retrieves data. This operation returns a query ID that can be used in subsequent operations to retrieve more records.

parameters.name: databaseId
parameters.description: Database to search. Must be a valid database ID, one of the following: BCI/BIOABS/BIOSIS/CCC/DCI/DIIDW/MEDLINE/WOK/WOS/ZOOREC. WOK represents all databases.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of search. This element can take only one value: en for English. If no language is specified, English is passed by default.

parameters.name: usrQuery
parameters.description: User query for requesting data, ex: TS=(cadmium). The query parser will return errors for invalid queries.

parameters.name: edition
parameters.description: Edition(s) to be searched. If null, user permissions will be substituted. Must include the name of the collection and edition name separated by '+', ex: WOS+SCI. Multiple editions are separated by ','. Editions available for collection(WOS) - AHCI,CCR,IC,ISSHP,ISTP,SCI,SSCI,BHCI,BSCI and ESCI.

parameters.name: publishTimeSpan
parameters.description: This element specifies a range of publication dates. If publishTimeSpan is used, the loadTimeSpan parameter must be omitted. If publishTimeSpan and loadTimeSpan are both omitted, then the maximum time span will be inferred from the editions data. Beginning and end dates should be specified in the yyyy-mm-dd format separated by +, ex: 1993-01-01+2009-12-31.

parameters.name: loadTimeSpan
parameters.description: Load time span (otherwise described as symbolic time span) defines a range of load dates. The load date is the date a record was added to the database. If load date is specified, the publishTimeSpan parameter must be omitted. If both publishTimeSpan and loadTimeSpan are omitted, the maximum publication date will be inferred from the editions data. Any of D/W/M/Y prefixed with a number where D-Day, M-Month, W-Week, Y-Year allowed. Acceptable value range for Day(0-6), Week(1-52), Month(1-12) and Year(0-10), ex: 5D,30W,10M,8Y.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of records to return, must be 0-100.

parameters.name: firstRecord
parameters.description: Specific record, if any within the result set to return. Cannot be less than 1 and greater than 100000.

parameters.name: sortField
parameters.description: Order by field(s). Field name and order by clause separated by '+', use A for ASC and D for DESC, ex: PY+D. Multiple values are separated by comma.

X-RateLimit-Remaining-second.description: The number of requests left for the second window.

X-RateLimit-Limit-second.description: The number of requests limit per second.

x-paginate-by-query-id.description:
The url of the next page in case your `RecordsFound > count + firstRecord`
Please use this url for pagination. The queryId will live for four hours only.

get.description: This operation returns a record identified by a unique identifier. You may specify multiple identifiers in a single request.

parameters.name: databaseId
parameters.description: Database to search. Must be a valid database ID, one of the following: BCI/BIOABS/BIOSIS/CCC/DCI/DIIDW/MEDLINE/WOK/WOS/ZOOREC. WOK represents all databases.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of search. This element can take only one value: en for English. If no language is specified, English is passed by default.

parameters.name: uniqueId
parameters.description: Primary item(s) id to be searched, ex: WOS:000270372400005. Cannot be null or an empty string. Multiple values are separated by comma.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of records returned in the request

parameters.name: firstRecord
parameters.description: Specific record, if any within the result set to return. Cannot be less than 1 and greater than 100000.

parameters.name: sortField
parameters.description: Order by field(s). Field name and order by clause separated by '+', use A for ASC and D for DESC, ex: PY+D. Multiple values are separated by comma.

X-RateLimit-Remaining-second.description: The number of requests left for the second window.

X-RateLimit-Limit-second.description: The number of requests limit per second.

get.description: This operation returns record(s) identified by a query identifier.

parameters.name: queryId
parameters.description: Retrieve records based on query identifier.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of records to return, must be 0-100.

parameters.name: firstRecord
parameters.description: Specific record, if any within the result set to return. Cannot be less than 1 and greater than 100000.

parameters.name: sortField
parameters.description: Order by field(s). Field name and order by clause separated by '+', use A for ASC and D for DESC, ex: PY+D. Multiple values are separated by comma. If sortField was set on the original query, this parameter should be set as sorting is not a property of the query.

X-RateLimit-Remaining-second.description: The number of requests left for the second window.

X-RateLimit-Limit-second.description: The number of requests limit per second.

x-paginate-by-query-id.description:
The url of the next page in case your `RecordsFound > count + firstRecord`
Please use this url for pagination. The QueryId will live for four hours in case if inactivity.

X-RateLimit-Remaining-second.description: The number of requests left for the second window.

X-RateLimit-Limit-second.description: The number of requests limit per second.

Data.description: The array of the Web of Science records

QueryID.description:
The ID of the query that can be used for pagination. 
Note: The id will expire after four hours (session duration) and during a session you can have maximum 2,500 Queries. 
The QueryIDs will be reused (starting from 1) if more than 2,500 queries are requested within a session. 
The session will expire after four hours inactivity, 
i.e. no requests with the token. 
Use always `x-paginate-by-query-id` Header to paginate through records. The response time will be faster by using QueryID.

RecordsSearched.description: The overrall number of records available in Web of Science.

RecordsFound.description: The number of records of your request that are filtered through usrQuery but as well other query parameters.

UT.description: The unique identifier of Web of Science Record

items.example: Comparative efficiency of rice husk-derived biochar (RHB) and steel slag (SS) on cadmium (Cd) mobility and its uptake by Chinese cabbage in highly contaminated soil

code.description: The error code (mostly the HTTP status description)

message.description: A detailed message of the error that helps you to correct your request.
message.example: Server.Parser.ILL_TAG_NAME, Translation Exception : Illegal tag name UNKOWN

id.description: The request ID which can be used for investigation purposes.

Source.description: The source of this article; journal, book or medium in which the document was published

SourceTitle.description: The title of the source in which the document was published

SpecialIssue.description: Special issue, in case was published to a special issue journal

BookSeriesTitle.description: Book series title - in case the article is published in book series

BookGroupAuthors.description: Book authors if In case of a book series

Other.description: The source of this article; journal, book or medium in which the document was published

Identifier.Eissn.description: Electronic International Standard Identifier Number. [What is an ISSN?](https://www.issn.org/understanding-the-issn/what-is-an-issn/)

Contributor.ResearcherID.ResearcherIDs.description: ResearcherID provided from Web of Science. [What is my Web of Science ResearcherID?](https://publons.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/12000038281-what-is-my-web-of-science-researcherid-)

Contributor.ResearcherID.Names.description: The author names in the same order from `Contributor.ResearcherID.ResearcherIDs`

Identifier.Issn.description: International Standard Identifier Number. [What is an ISSN?](https://www.issn.org/understanding-the-issn/what-is-an-issn/)

Identifier.Isbn.description: International Standard Book Number. [What is an ISBN?](https://www.isbn-international.org/content/what-isbn)

Identifier.Ids.description: The IDS Number is included in the export from Web of Science to Researcher Solutions products. The ISI Document Delivery Number is used to uniquely identify documents that can be delivered via IDS. It is of no particular use if the user does not wish to use our document delivery.
